questions.questionText: hour Additional Materials: Multiple Choice Answer Sheet Soft clean eraser Soft pencil (type B or HB is recommended) READ THESE INSTRUCTIONS FIRST Write in soft pencil. Do not use staples, paper clips, highlighters, glue or correction fluid. Write your name, Centre number and candidate number on the Answer Sheet in the spaces provided unless this has been done for you. There are thirty questions on this paper. Answer all questions. For each question there are four possible answers A, B, C and D. Choose the one you consider correct and record your choice in soft pencil on the separate Answer Sheet. Read the instructions on the Answer Sheet very carefully. Each correct answer will score one mark. A mark will not be deducted for a wrong answer. Any rough working should be done in this booklet. Calculators may be used.

questions.questionText: What might stop financial statements showing a true and fair view?

options.A: changes in depreciation methods from year to year
options.C: creation of an asset revaluation reserve
options.D: inclusion of purchased goodwill in a balance sheet

questions.questionText: A company has been depreciating its IT equipment over 5 years, but now finds that it is becoming obsolete in 3 years. What does the consistency principle permit the company to do?

options.A: change the depreciation policy to 3 years and highlight the effect of this in its financial statements
options.B: change the depreciation policy to 3 years without indicating the effect on profits
options.C: continue to depreciate over 5 years as per the existing policy
options.D: continue to depreciate over 5 years but note that after 3 years the equipment will be obsolete

questions.questionText: Which error would cause an entry in the suspense account?

options.A: A page total from the purchases journal was posted as $9780 rather than the correct figure of $9870.
options.B: Carriage outwards is credited to the carriage outwards account but correctly accounted for in the cash book.
options.C: Discounts allowed are debited to the discounts allowed account and credited to the purchases ledger control account.
options.D: Repairs to a vehicle are debited to the vehicles account.

questions.questionText: A company’s purchases ledger control account showed an opening balance of $24 640 credit. The following information is available for the year. $ purchases journal (including invoice for $910 entered twice) 17 100 receivables ledger control contra 850 credit notes issued by suppliers 1 250 discounts received 420 The purchases ledger control account balance at the year end was $19 870 credit. How much cash was paid to creditors during the year?

How much are the bank charges?

Y has made a loan to the partnership on which the partnership pays interest of $5000 each year. Profit for the year before appropriations is $150 000. What is Z’s total appropriation of profit for the year?

Which type of preference shares does the investor own?
